title: Interruptability Scorecard and Tactical Recon Protocol
creator: Asha Menon
description: Build a repeatable, score-driven mechanism that standardizes how we evaluate model 'interruptability' — i.e., the operational and commercial risk of a model becoming partially or fully unavailable, or changing behavior due to quantization/variant substitution. This ticket scopes a) a quantitative scorecard (signals + weights), b) a telemetry-backed dashboard for continuous monitoring, and c) a tactical recon protocol that prescribes actions (pre-provision, canary swaps, comms) when thresholds breach. Output will feed procurement triggers and runbooks for Dedicated/Private sales conversations.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard spec document published with at least 7 signals and weighting rationale (latency variance, regional availability, release churn, kernel compatibility, quantization-tested coverage, SLA delta, customer usage concentration).
Prototype telemetry pipeline pushing daily interruptability scores for top 50 models into Grafana and a raw CSV export in S3.
Tactical recon protocol drafted with three escalation tiers (monitor-only, pre-provision, emergency fallback) and example playbooks for each tier.
Procurement integration: mapping from score thresholds to procurement/contract recommendations (e.g., reserved capacity, penalty clauses, alternative model inventory).
Stakeholder signoff from Eng (runtime), Sales SWE, and Customer Success recorded in comments.
tasks: Define signals and preliminary weights (PM + Research)
Instrument telemetry: latency variance & regional outage signals (Eng infra)
Run competitive sweep: collect public SLA/availability & release cadence for major open and hosted models
Build Grafana panels and CSV export for score history
Draft tactical recon protocol and tabletop scenarios
Align procurement mapping and draft recommended contract language snippets
Run 1-week pilot with 10 customer workloads and capture false-positive rate
